source.original_paper: Zhuravleva et al 2004 J Mol Biol DOI 10.1016/j.jmb.2004.08.001
source.protein: Cu(I) reduced azurin, Pseudomonas aeruginosa native 128aa at pH 5.5
source.original_units: T1,T2 in seconds; R1/R2 inverse seconds using first-order error propagation

source_and_computations.source_tests: GitHub Actions source-identity-geometry-and-no-leakage seven of seven PASS, general repo verify PASS
source_and_computations.actual_calculator_execution: Authorized connected user's desktop Yaksa, same source file/commit prior to PR merge; no Rowan provider access; not independently rerun full numeric fit on Github Actions, only source-tests ran there

predictive_results.quantity: Median over residues of sum of three squared (prediction-observation)/source_SE at TEST 800MHz; lower is better. Very large values mean failed adequacy under reported SE, not biological truth.

interpretation.primary_result: Transferable physical predictive adequacy on new protein NOT ACHIEVED under precommitted three-field two-temperature model grid. Zero residues passed joint heldout 2-SE in both temperatures for all four model variants.
interpretation.relative_289K: Allowing variable CSA reduces median combined loss, BUT axial models select spherical boundary and R1 loss worsens. No evidence shared rotational anisotropy at 289K in tested model.
interpretation.relative_317K: Single global axial ratio=1.5 chosen in training for both structurally oriented axial models, improving median loss relative to isotropic baseline, but all predictions still fail absolute 2-SE triple criterion. M2 worsens NOE, and M3 has large errors.
interpretation.source_uncertainty_note: Errors are deposited nominal experimental SE; unknown covariance, sample mismatch, hydrogen placement error and coarse parameter grid can dominate. No p values or uncertainty calibration.
interpretation.physical_qualification: N-H direction is estimated chemically from heavy atoms deposited in PDB1E5Y, NOT observed amide protons; shape PCA axis is an arbitrary *physically grounded surrogate*, NOT measured hydrodynamic diffusion tensor symmetry axis. Thus anisotropy is NOT physically confirmed or disproven.
interpretation.CSA_identifiability: Upper CSA bound -120ppm reached in 34/116 (289K M1/M3), 75/114 (317K M1) or 55/114 (317K M3), indicating insufficient identifiability and/or model mismatch; do not claim actual CSA experimentally determined.
interpretation.FN1_implications: Azurin test validates neither FNII domain angles nor Rowan Boltz2 protein correctness. Need revised independent physical calibration, multiple structural conformers/shape approximations, site-specific CSA, Rex sensitivity, and other proteins. No retuning original heldout test after observing results.
